purpose: Provide a pure undercutting example in which identity remains undecided and only the evidential role of coarse structural similarity is defeated.

observed_evidence_E.observed_response: r_i[t+1] = o[t] for both systems and every observed input history
observed_evidence_E.consequence: Observed data do not constrain response sensitivity to p because the channel is inactive throughout E.

R_pred.coarse_similarity_I: A and B have the same observed predictive mapping

R_fine.evidence_status: E leaves theta_A and theta_B unconstrained

identity_question_Q: Do A and B instantiate the same cognitive-capacity type?
criterion_C: Capacity type is individuated partly by stable counterfactual organization over a declared intervention family J.

intervention_family_J.P_star: Apply the same external operation p[t] <- 1 to either system under the matched test condition.
intervention_family_J.reason_common: The operation changes the same externally manipulable channel p in both systems; no system-specific output rule is introduced.

inferential_status.not_rebutting_reason: R_fine does not establish theta_A != theta_B and P_star has not been performed.
inferential_status.undercutting_reason: R_pred's coarse similarity I cannot discriminate two C-relevant counterfactual completions that are equally compatible with E.
inferential_status.consequence: If I plays a substantial role in support of H_id, its evidential contribution is undercut until P_star or an equivalent discriminating consideration resolves the live alternative.
